description: This file defines a SwiftUI view for the 'About' or 'Settings' screen of a macOS application named 'OpenClaw'. It includes UI components displaying app information, external links, and update controls, and interacts with updater logic and app configuration.

classes.name: AboutSettings

classes.name: AboutLinkRow
classes.description: A reusable SwiftUI view for displaying a clickable link with an icon, which opens a URL.

classes.name: AboutMetaRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for displaying label-value pair information in the about section.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main SwiftUI view content for AboutSettings, constructing the UI layout.
